name: deleteMessages
description: Use this method to delete multiple messages simultaneously. If some of the specified messages can't be found, they are skipped. Returns _True_ on success.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup or channel in the format `@username`

parameters.name: message_ids
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized list of 1-100 identifiers of messages to delete. See [deleteMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletemessage) for limitations on which messages can be deleted.
